title: Databases under pressure
description: Return exactly four columns: server_name, name, size_mb, connection_usage_percent. Include only online databases where size_mb is at least 51200 or connection_usage_percent is at least 80. Sort by connection_usage_percent DESC, then name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT server_name, name, size_mb, connection_usage_percent
FROM databases
hints: Combine size and connection conditions with OR, while status must apply to the whole group.
Parentheses around the OR conditions matter here.
solution_explanation: Parentheses prevent OR from bypassing the status = online filter.
